summary: Verified Sales → Təkliflər (CompanyDatabase.jsx) Yeni Lead redesign + picker flow. Design change (dashed 'Mövcud şirkət bazasından seç' button) works, hint banner works, submit closes modal cleanly, POST body is scrubbed of _picked_from_db/_picked_company_id flags, and Bug#3 validation now properly keeps modal open with a clear Azerbaijani error toast. Two issues remain: (1) source select UI doesn't reflect 'Baza' (placeholder shows because 'Baza' is not a SelectItem), and (2) more critically the created lead persists with source='' instead of 'Baza' — violating the acceptance criterion 7d.

ui_bugs.issue: After picking a company from DB, the 'Mənbə' select trigger still shows the 'Seçin' placeholder — because the picker sets form.source='Baza' but there is no <SelectItem value='Baza'> in the SelectContent (lead_sources API returns ['Marketing','Referans','Sosial media','Veb sayt','Sərgi','Soyuq zəng','Digər']). User has no visual confirmation that source was auto-defaulted.

The lead that ACTUALLY gets POSTed after using the DB picker has source='' — not 'Baza'. Verified by: (a) intercepted POST /api/sales-leads body shows { "source": "" ... }, (b) GET /api/sales-leads returns the newly created lead with source='', (c) leads table Mənbə column is empty for the picker-created row. This fails acceptance criteria 2g and 3d. Most-likely root cause: Radix <Select value={form.source}> receives 'Baza' but there is no matching <SelectItem>, so on the next controlled render Radix normalises the unknown value away (and/or a subsequent onValueChange fires with '') — the visual 'Seçin' state in bug #1 is the same symptom. Recommended fix: EITHER add a permanent <SelectItem value='Baza'>Baza</SelectItem> inside SelectContent (independent of the sources array), OR add 'Baza' to the lead_sources options in the backend /api/options/all response so it always appears as an item.

action_items: Ensure form.source='Baza' actually survives to the POST body after using the DB picker. Simplest fix: add <SelectItem value='Baza'>Baza</SelectItem> at the top of the Mənbə SelectContent in /app/frontend/src/pages/CompanyDatabase.jsx (~line 489) so Radix can render/hold the value AND the user sees 'Baza' in the trigger. Alternatively, extend backend lead_sources to include 'Baza'.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The critical remaining bug is that source='Baza' from the picker does NOT reach the POST body — it becomes ''. Add <SelectItem value='Baza'>Baza</SelectItem> at the top of the Mənbə SelectContent in CompanyDatabase.jsx (around line 489) OR include 'Baza' in the lead_sources array returned by /api/options/all. After the fix, retest: (a) pick company from DB, (b) assert Mənbə trigger shows 'Baza' text, (c) submit and GET the created lead — expect source=='Baza'. All other acceptance criteria are already passing.
rca of the issue: Radix UI Select is controlled via value={form.source}. When picker sets form.source='Baza' but no <SelectItem value='Baza'> exists inside SelectContent, Radix has no matching Item to render as the selected state; the trigger falls back to <SelectValue placeholder='Seçin' />. On subsequent controlled re-renders (or on any interaction that touches the Select), the mismatched value is not preserved into the DOM and form.source effectively gets treated as empty by the time handleSubmit builds the payload. Confirmed by intercepting the POST body: source='' rather than 'Baza'. Fix is trivial — render a 'Baza' SelectItem so Radix has something to bind to.
